signature.name: Mercedes-Benz Museum
signature.detail: A must-see for car lovers and anyone interested in the history of the automobile, tracing over 130 years of Mercedes-Benz. Book tickets online to skip the queue, and go early on weekdays for a quieter visit.

signature.name: Porsche Museum
signature.detail: A pilgrimage for sports-car fans, showcasing iconic Porsche models and racing heritage. It is easily reached by S-Bahn to Porscheplatz; allow a couple of hours and check opening days before you go.

signature.name: Fernsehturm Stuttgart
signature.detail: The world's first television tower and a Stuttgart icon, offering panoramic views over the city and surrounding hills. Visit at sunset for the best light, and buy tickets in advance during peak season.

signature.name: Staatsgalerie Stuttgart
signature.detail: One of Germany's most important art museums, with a celebrated collection from the old masters to modern art. The building itself is an architectural highlight; check for free-entry days and temporary exhibitions.

signature.name: Schlossplatz
signature.detail: The lively central square in front of the Neues Schloss, perfect for a stroll and people-watching. It is a short walk from the main station; come in the evening when the square is beautifully lit.

signature.name: Wilhelma Zoo and Botanical Garden
signature.detail: A combined zoo and botanical garden in a historic park, great for families and a relaxing half-day. Go on a weekday morning to avoid crowds, and wear comfortable shoes for the extensive grounds.

signature.name: Stuttgart City Library
signature.detail: A striking modern building with a famous white interior, a hit with architecture fans and photographers. Entry is free; visit during opening hours and be respectful of readers.

transport: S-Bahn/U-Bahn single ticket about $3; day pass around $8
